specification.objective: Prepare the Magi 1.8.2 patch-version metadata and dated notes for IPC model-override consent hardening, without changing runtime behavior or publishing a release.

requirements.statement: The plugin manifest, npm test-package metadata and lockfile root entries, README, and current compatibility document titles consistently report version 1.8.2.
The dated 1.8.2 changelog entry accurately records explicit llm.model_override consent and IPC protocol-v2 rejection of legacy listeners, while preserving 1.8.1 and older history.
The metadata-only bump does not change runtime behavior or dependencies, and the existing metadata assertion and full test suite pass.

acceptance_criteria.statement: All authoritative version sources equal 1.8.2 and the existing metadata test verifies their consistency.
The dated 1.8.2 changelog mentions model-override consent and protocol-v2 legacy-server rejection, and all prior release sections remain intact.
The full CI test command and coverage gate pass with no runtime or dependency changes.

invariants.statement: No runtime/plugin logic, dependency versions, Hermes configuration, credentials, or memory data are changed.
No Git tag or hosted release is created; this request prepares source metadata only.

forbidden_states.statement: Version sources disagree, historical release notes are lost, or the 1.8.2 section is absent.
Runtime behavior, dependencies, or a Git tag/hosted release are changed or published.

inputs.statement: The clean baseline is main at 8d342937a76106a3b133d34aa08fd2a105a18bb9 with current metadata version 1.8.1.
The post-1.8.1 IPC-hardening change requires explicit model-override consent and protocol v2.
The current source changelog format uses dated version sections and preserves historical sections.

outputs.statement: Consistent 1.8.2 version metadata and dated changelog, validated as behavior-preserving without a tag or hosted release.

failure_semantics.statement: If metadata consistency or required tests/coverage fail, do not commit or push the version bump.
